gaps.detail: the product page's Colour picker writes state key "curSwatch" over each product's own list "cols", but the basket line does not read it, so the shopper's pick never reaches the basket; it is made the "Colour" choice (one variation per option) on 16 products and the omission is listed as a draft defect

defect.declares: a colour picker on the product page that writes "curSwatch" over each product's own list "cols", so the shopper chooses a colour for the product
defect.renders: the basket line (in Eye Care Birmingham.dc.html) never reads "curSwatch", so which colour the shopper chose is not in the basket and the line cannot tell one colour of the product from another
